---
name: freehub-service-log
description: Symptoms and fix for loaner-wheel freehub pawls disengaging under load
---

The pawls stop engaging when the grease thickens, usually part-way up a climb: the cranks turn
and the wheel does not. Strip the freehub and re-grease with a light oil, never the heavy tub
grease. **It does not silently corrupt the hub, which is the whole point** — the failure is loud
and immediate, so nobody rides away on a wheel that is about to let go.

Related: [[wheel-build-notes]]
